context_contrasts.known_in_actual_context: ERK phosphorylation of NUP50 changes importin-beta/transportin interactions and their migration in a permeabilized assay.
context_contrasts.actual_endpoint: receptor association and migration, not motor-neuron cargo flux
context_contrasts.negative_or_boundary: No direct ALS phenotype measured in this source material.
context_contrasts.prohibited_transfer: Do not treat receptor migration as a direct measurement of cargo import in intact motor neurons.
context_contrasts.required_transfer_assumption: Comparable NUP50 phosphorylation affects relevant cargo transport in the proposed disease-relevant cells.

context_contrasts.known_in_actual_context: CDK1/cyclin B can phosphorylate the indicated NUP50 sites in a separate in-vitro assay.
context_contrasts.negative_or_boundary: Site detection cannot uniquely assign ERK as the physiological kinase.
context_contrasts.prohibited_transfer: Do not infer exclusive ERK causation from S221/S315 signal alone.
context_contrasts.required_transfer_assumption: Kinase identity must be independently established in the selected cells.

context_contrasts.known_in_actual_context: NUP50 depletion in HT22 cells impaired a reporter export phenotype and increased neuronal death in reported systems.
context_contrasts.source_context: HT22 mouse hippocampal cells; other survival assays in primary cortical neurons
context_contrasts.actual_endpoint: NLS-mCherry-NES reporter export, endogenous TDP-43 localization/splicing measures, survival
context_contrasts.negative_or_boundary: Endogenous TDP-43 localization and two splicing measures did not change in this reported setting.
context_contrasts.prohibited_transfer: Do not equate depletion with phosphorylation or use these results as proof of ALS-specific phosphorylation pathology.
context_contrasts.required_transfer_assumption: If relevant, the abundance phenotype and modification phenotype can be experimentally disentangled.

context_contrasts.known_in_actual_context: Ran-related dysfunction offers a distinct ALS-related transport mechanism.
context_contrasts.negative_or_boundary: Does not establish a NUP50 modification mechanism.
context_contrasts.prohibited_transfer: Do not assume all transport impairment arises upstream from NUP50 phosphorylation.
context_contrasts.required_transfer_assumption: A candidate needs a discriminator against Ran-driven impairment.

context_contrasts.known_in_actual_context: CHMP7-linked NPC injury provides an alternative route to NPC/transport damage.
context_contrasts.actual_endpoint: NPC injury and disease-associated molecular dysfunction
context_contrasts.negative_or_boundary: Does not establish a phosphorylation-mediated initiating mechanism.
context_contrasts.prohibited_transfer: Do not attribute pore-structure damage uniquely to phosphorylation.
context_contrasts.required_transfer_assumption: A modification mechanism should distinguish early functional effects from general structural injury.

context_contrasts.known_in_actual_context: Directionality of TDP-43 and NPC changes can depend on model and stage.
context_contrasts.source_context: reported TDP-43/NPC genetic and cellular models
context_contrasts.negative_or_boundary: Reverse causality remains a relevant alternative.
context_contrasts.prohibited_transfer: Do not force TDP-43 loss as a necessary consequence of every NUP50 change.
context_contrasts.required_transfer_assumption: Temporal order and mediation require independent testing.

allowed_input.original_goal: Propose a novel, testable mechanism by which phosphorylation of a nuclear pore complex nucleoporin may contribute to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Explain the molecular mechanism and suggest feasible validation experiments.
allowed_input.neutral_orientation: Research sources discuss ALS-related nuclear-pore changes and nucleoporin modification in diverse experimental contexts; none by itself establishes the requested causal connection.
allowed_input.search_constraints: Search broadly across hypotheses, including mechanisms that need not involve transport. Record actual sources and contradictions.

forbidden_inputs: NUP50-AMPK metabolic explanation as a preselected target
OpenSeedInitialInputIsolation.after_its_own_search_may_form_new_direct: The v0.3 study eventually discussed energy-responsive NUP50 mechanisms, but this is NOT assumed to have emerged from an isolated run in the present example.

HypothesisIllustrativeNotModelExecuted.derived_from_v03_study: SIM-I0 and its evaluated limitations; not an independent generation experiment
HypothesisIllustrativeNotModelExecuted.scoped_claim: If a disease-relevant neuronal population has reduced NUP50 abundance, a particular reversible NUP50 phosphorylation state may disproportionately delay receptor-dependent cargo-transport recovery, contributing to injury before widespread NPC disassembly.
HypothesisIllustrativeNotModelExecuted.biological_context: proposed ALS-relevant neuronal system; low-NUP50 status and specific phosphosite must be established in the selected system

mechanism_steps.statement: NUP50 phosphorylation can change transport-receptor binding in studied non-neuronal systems.
Some ALS-related experimental systems have reduced NUP50 or NUP50-associated phenotypes.
NUP50 abundance modifies sensitivity to a particular phosphorylation state in ALS-related cells.
Delayed nuclear-transport recovery contributes to later neuronal vulnerability.

assumption_ledger.necessary_bridge: Reversible NUP50 phosphorylation state occurs in selected neurons
Low abundance interacts with phosphorylation state
assumption_ledger.proposed_check: compare factor effects at matched conditions

assumption_ledger.necessary_bridge: Time-resolved recovery has causal relevance to injury
assumption_ledger.proposed_check: separate transport readout and later injury

prediction.comparison: NUP50 abundance (normal/reduced) x modification state (verified states)
prediction.hypothesis_prediction: A larger state-dependent delay in time-resolved receptor-dependent cargo transport recovery at lower abundance.
prediction.alternative_prediction: A general Ran defect or structural pore loss need not produce the specified abundance-by-state interaction.

HypothesisIllustrativeNotModelExecuted.falsification: With adequate verified interventions and measurement precision, the predicted interaction and relevant recovery phenotype fail to occur.
